clauses.text:
Executive Order 12187 of December 29, 1979
Base Production Control Level for M arginal Properties
B y the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and statutes o f 
the United States o f A m erica, including the Emergency Petroleum A llocation 
A c t o f 1973, as am ended (15 U .S .C . 751 e t se q.), and notwithstanding the 
delegations to the Secretary o f Energy in Executive Order N o. 11790, as 
am ended by Executive Order N o. 12038, and in order to delay the decontrol o f 
m arginal oil w ells, it is hereby ordered as follows:
1-101. For purposes o f the pricing regulations adopted pursuant to the Emer­
gency Petroleum A llocation A c t o f 1973, with respect to months commencing 
after Decem ber 31, 1979, the base production control level for m arginal 
properties shall equal 20 percent o f the total number o f barrels o f old crude oil 
produced and sold from the property concerned during calendar year 1978, 
divided by 365, multiplied by the number o f days during the month in 1978 
w hich corresponds to the month concerned.
1-102. For purposes o f this Order, the term “ m arginal properties” has the same 
m eaning as that term under the crude oil pricing regulations adopted pursuant 
to the Emergency Petroleum A llocation A c t o f 1973, as am ended.
1-103. The Secretary o f Energy m ay, pursuant to Executive Order N o. 11790, as 
am ended by Executive Order N o. 12038, adopt such regulations as he deems 
necessary or appropriate to conform the crude oil pricing regulations to this 
Order.

versions.research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12187 (45 FR 3, Federal Register of January 2, 1980; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed Base Production Control Level for Marginal Properties and signed December 29, 1979. It sets the base production control level for marginal oil properties. Inventory: three numbered sections (1-101 to 1-103), recorded as one whole clause; the dossier inventory matches the full held text. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12187, whose subject line describes providing for the base production control level for marginal properties. Executive Order 12209 (1980-04-16) restated the order and is a later event, not an end.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found citations of this number outside its own printings only in the printings of EO 12209. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
